en.bdb: Example of a wild fig tree

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਲਰ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਭੁਣਹਣਾ ਗੁਲਰ ਨੋਂ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: gular a(n)dhar bhunahanaa gular no(n) brahama(n)dd vakhaanai|

en.bdb: Fig is the cosmos for the insect living in it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਲਰ ਲਗਣਿ ਲਖ ਫਲ ਇਕ ਦੂ ਲਖ ਅਲਖ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: gular lagan lakh fal ik dhoo lakh alakh na jaanai|

en.bdb: But on a tree grows millions of fruits which multiply further in numberless quantity.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਲਖ ਬਿਰਖ ਬਗੀਚਿਅਹੁ ਲਖ ਬਗੀਚੇ ਬਾਗ ਵਖਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: lakh lakh birakh bageechiahu lakh bageeche baag vakhaanai|

en.bdb: Gardens are there of  myriad trees and likewise are millions of gardens in the world.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਬਾਗ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਵਿਚਿ ਲਖ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਲੂਅ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: lakh baag brahama(n)dd vich lakh brahama(n)dd looa vich aanai|

en.bdb: Millions of  universes are there in one small hair of God.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਿਹਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਜੇ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: mihar kare je miharavaan gurmukh saadhasa(n)gat ra(n)g maanai|

en.bdb: If that kind God showers His  grace, only then a gurmukh can enjoy the delight of the holy congregation.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਪਾ ਖਾਕੁ ਹੋਇ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਦੇ ਚਲੈ ਓਹੁ ਭਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: pairee pai paa khaak hoi saahib dhe chalai oh bhaanai|

en.bdb: Only then falling on the feet and becoming dust, the humble one can mould  himself according to the divine Will (hukam) of the Lord.
Only when ego is  erased, this fact is realized and identified.
